patches.name: Add archive links to menus
patches.description: Adds Wayback Machine and archive.today options to the menu behind a post's overflow button and to the one behind a link, next to "Open in browser". Useful for reading a page that has since been taken down or put behind a paywall. Nothing is requested until one of them is tapped.

patches.name: Automatically undelete Imgur media
patches.description: Loads Imgur images and videos that no longer exist from the Wayback Machine, including the still shown for a video in a feed. Imgur removed a large amount of older content, so links in old posts often fail. Nothing is requested until a link has actually failed, and only what the archive happens to hold can be recovered.

patches.name: Automatically undelete Reddit content
patches.description: Restores the text of removed posts and comments from Project Arctic Shift, and the name of an author whose account has since been deleted. A comment says why it was taken down on the line under its author. Only text can be recovered, and only where the archive has it.

patches.name: Disable Sync for Lemmy bottom sheet
patches.description: Disables the bottom sheet at the startup that asks you to signup to "Sync for Lemmy".

patches.name: Enable Android debugging
patches.description: Enables Android developer debugging capabilities. Including this patch can slow down the app.

patches.name: Fix Imgur links
patches.description: Sync resolves Imgur links through a proxy of its own that no longer exists, so they fail to load. Answers those requests locally instead. Album contents are read from an archived copy of the album page, which only works for albums the archive captured while Imgur still rendered them.

patches.name: Fix post thumbnails
patches.description: Fixes loading post thumbnails by correcting their URLs.

patches.name: Fix video downloads
patches.description: Fixes a bug in Sync's MPD parser resulting in only the audio-track being saved.

patches.name: Modify login WebView
patches.description: Modify the WebView used for logging into reddit to prevent login issues

patches.name: Recover post thumbnails from the archive
patches.description: Restores the thumbnail beside a post whose Reddit preview has been purged, which is why an old Imgur album shows a blank tile even though opening it works. The linked image is fetched from the Wayback Machine only once its preview has actually failed.

patches.name: Redirect Gfycat links to RedGifs
patches.description: Answers Gfycat requests from RedGifs, which hosts much of the content that moved there before Gfycat shut down. Gfycat's domains no longer resolve, so without this every Gfycat link fails to load.

patches.name: Show a hidden profile from the archive
patches.description: Fills in a profile Reddit answers with nothing. An account can hide what it has written from its own profile, which Sync shows as a user with no posts, while Project Arctic Shift still serves what it recorded when those posts and comments were public. Only a profile that comes back empty is filled in, and only its posts and comments tabs.

patches.name: Show videos posted in comments
patches.description: Draws a video posted in a comment in the comment, and plays it when tapped. Reddit writes one into the comment as a link to a player page on its own site, which Sync can only hand to a browser, where it opens on an address naming no subreddit and is answered with a banned notice. Pointed at the video itself, Sync draws it beside the comment the way it does any other media, and plays the whole video in its own player. Sync's own "Inline image previews" setting governs whether it is drawn.

patches.name: Spoof client
patches.description: Restores functionality of the app by using custom client ID.

options.title: OAuth client ID
options.description: The Reddit OAuth client ID. Refer to Sync Up documentation for more information on what to put here.

options.title: Redirect URI
options.description: The Reddit OAuth redirect URI. Refer to Sync Up documentation for more information on what to put here. Default value is RedReader's redirect URI.

options.title: User agent
options.description: The app's user agent. Refer to Sync Up documentation for more information on what to put here. Default value is RedReader's user agent.

patches.name: Use /user/ endpoint
patches.description: Replaces the deprecated endpoint for viewing user profiles /u with /user, that used to fix a bug.
